slides.headline: Simulate a trading firm with AI agents
slides.say: I found a GitHub project that lets you simulate a trading firm with AI agents for research.

slides.headline: What it does
slides.body: Multi-agent framework that simulates a trading firm using AI agents for research
slides.say: This tool lets you run a full trading firm simulation with AI agents doing research, analysis, and trading decisions.

slides.headline: 113,800 GitHub stars
slides.body: Apache-2.0 licence · Written in Python · Since December 2024
slides.say: It has over 110 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the Apache-2.0 licence.

slides.headline: Important caveat
slides.body: For research only, not financial advice; performance varies by models and data
slides.say: This is for research only, not financial advice. Results depend on the models and data you use.
